meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂目标拆成可核验步骤并循环推进
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果面对多步任务且想留痕、按步骤推进
copy.tagline_en: Break complex goals into verifiable steps and iterate to completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face multi-step tasks and want to keep evidence-based progress

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把目标拆成细步骤并登记清单，先注册目标再逐步执行；每步从真实界面采集证据，原子化提交；断点后先读回记录再继续，不推倒重来。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”“ulw”等关键词，或要求持久目标执行、证据导向的工作等时触发。

say.text: 请用 ulw-loop 把这项任务拆成细步骤并逐步执行
say.note: 会先注册目标，然后按清单推进

say.text: 这个开发任务按证据导向的方式走 ulw-loop 流程
say.note: 每步会留下可验证证据

say.text: 开启一个可断点的长任务，登记目标和检查点再执行
say.note: 进入证据导向的执行循环

howto.what_en: Claude splits the goal into tiny logged steps, runs one at a time, captures evidence from a real surface, commits each verified unit atomically, and resumes from checkpoints instead of replanning from scratch.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention ulw-loop or ulw keywords, or ask for durable goal execution / evidence-led work with checkpoints.

say_en.text: Please use ulw-loop to break this task into steps and run them.
say_en.note: It registers the goal first, then works the list.

say_en.text: Take this dev task through evidence-led ulw-loop steps.
Start a checkpointed long task: register goal and checkpoints, then run.
